differentiation.occupancy_preservation: The source-conditioned assignment term moves codewords to change which existing cells receive pair endpoints; the barrier penalizes distinct participating codewords whose distance falls below the specified floor. It therefore promotes reassignment among separated cells rather than pulling a pair's two codewords together. It does not guarantee cell sizes or hard-SID changes.

vs_r8.why: Unlike encoder-only terms, this objective has a direct codebook gradient, so it can affect exported SIDs despite host gradient assembly. Unlike the collapsed cross-entropy, it includes an explicit penalty against reducing the distance between distinct pair-associated codewords. Unlike a pure merge objective, its intended operation is to alter soft cell memberships while maintaining codeword separation; occupancy and downstream behavior remain empirical risks, not assumed guarantees.

differentiation.vs_reference_arm: the reference arm is the untouched host; this candidate adds one term whose gradient reaches the codebook without pulling a transition's two codewords together

equation: Let p_k(x)=softmax_k(-||x-c_k||^2/tau). Define L = lambda * sum_i m_i * sum_k p_k(s_i) * sum_l p_l(t_i) * [log(p_l(t_i)+eps) + beta * (||c_k-c_l||^2-delta^2)^2], with the separation term applied only to k != l. The directed assignment term is evaluated with source-conditioned weights p_k(s_i); source and target are not interchangeable.
expected_failure_modes: The soft assignment pressure may be too weak to change hard assignments, or may change them by unevenly redistributing item mass despite the separation barrier. The barrier preserves geometric distance, not occupancy, prefix branching, train-to-test frequency drift, sequence information, or Stage-3 ranking quality.

forbidden_substitutions.reason: a quota on the assignment is the family that produced 39.5% and 24.2% occupancy without preserving the exported codes
a term that pulls a pair's two codewords together is what collapsed the level-0 codebook to two codes

hypotheses: On the admitted cold run, measure the frozen held-out pair-level ER, level-0 code count and Gini, L1-to-L2 branches per L1 code, train-to-test frequency drift, sequence information, and Stage-3 recall@10/NDCG@10. The mechanism is falsified if Stage-3 quality does not exceed the archived control or if ER rises only alongside a violation of the required structure.

symbols.c_k: Codeword k in the supplied codebook.
symbols.delta: Minimum preferred distance between distinct codewords participating in a pair.
symbols.eps: Positive numerical stabilizer inside the logarithm.
symbols.m_i: Pair-validity mask value for pair i.
symbols.p_k(x): Soft assignment probability of embedding x to codeword k, computed from squared Euclidean distance and temperature tau.
